# Symphony README hero

Restored from the approved panoramic Symphony banner and edited with the built-in
ImageGen tool. The workspace identity in the embedded Inbox screenshot uses the
fictional labels `Example Workspace`, `example/project`, and `EW`. The composition
retains the rounded posthorn, wordmark, and complete Inbox window. This is an
editorial image; it does not define additional implemented product capabilities.

Only the corrected workspace identity area from the generated edit is composited
into the original raster. The final 2172 × 724 PNG preserves every original pixel
outside the rectangle at x=748–914 and y=82–116 (zero-based coordinates).
